from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,hashlib,time,uuid,urllib.parse,socket,shutil
r=Path.cwd();s=r/'.local/step07-ci-env/final';source=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip();w=r/json.loads((s/'workspace.json').read_text())['workspace'];env={**os.environ,'PATH':'/Users/dingshinn/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':'/dev/null','GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1'};rows=json.loads((s/'commands.json').read_text())['commands']
conf=dict(x.split('=',1)for x in(r/'.env').read_text().splitlines()if'='in x);u=urllib.parse.urlparse(conf['DATABASE_URL']);assert u.port==55476;env.update(API_HOST='127.0.0.1',API_PORT='4398',WEB_PORT='5298',STEP07_TEST_API_PORT='4398',INTEGRATION_API_PORT='4398',TILESET_PG_BIN='/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin');env.pop('MZ_CORE_PATH',None);env.pop('E2E_MODE',None)
for port in [4398,5298]:
 q=socket.socket();assert q.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1',port))!=0,'occupied no kill';q.close()
admin={**env,'PGHOST':'127.0.0.1','PGPORT':'55476','PGUSER':urllib.parse.unquote(u.username),'PGPASSWORD':urllib.parse.unquote(u.password or ''),'PGDATABASE':u.path[1:]};owners=json.loads((s/'resources-private.json').read_text())
def run(label,args,cwd,expected=0,patch=None):
 t=time.time();p=s/(label+'.log');e={**env,**(patch or {})};e={k:v for k,v in e.items()if v is not None}
 with p.open('w')as f:ret=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=e,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 b=p.read_bytes();o={'label':label,'args':args,'cwd':str(cwd.relative_to(r)),'source':source,'exitCode':ret.returncode,'expectedExit':expected,'durationSeconds':round(time.time()-t,3),'log':str(p.relative_to(r)),'logBytes':len(b),'logSHA256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'noDotEnv':not(w/'.env').exists()};rows.append(o);(s/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'commands':rows},indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:o[k]for k in ['label','exitCode','durationSeconds']}),flush=True);assert ret.returncode==expected,label
 return b
def newdb(label):
 name='[REDACTED_OWN_TEST_DB]'+label+'_'+uuid.uuid4().hex;args=['/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c','CREATE DATABASE "'+name+'"'];p=subprocess.run(args,env=admin,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT);q=s/(label+'-create-db.log');q.write_bytes(p.stdout);assert p.returncode==0;asset='.local/ci-env/'+label+'/assets';assert not(w/asset).exists();url=u._replace(path='/'+name).geturl();env.update(DATABASE_URL=url,TILESET_ASSET_ROOT=asset);owners.append({'purpose':label,'database':name,'assetRoot':str(w/asset),'owner':'step07 coder own fresh isolated check','PGPort':55476});(s/'resources-private.json').write_text(json.dumps(owners,indent=2)+'\n');(s/'resources-private.json').chmod(0o600);run(label+'-migrate',['pnpm','db:migrate'],w)

assert len(owners)==1 and owners[0]['purpose']=='regression'
env.update(DATABASE_URL=u._replace(path='/'+owners[0]['database']).geturl(),TILESET_ASSET_ROOT='.local/ci-env/regression/assets')
assert not(w/'.env').exists()
b=run('missing-config-expected-reject',['pnpm','exec','playwright','test','--list'],w,1,{'DATABASE_URL':None});assert b'E2E configuration requires DATABASE_URL' in b
b=run('invalid-config-expected-reject',['pnpm','exec','playwright','test','--list'],w,1,{'DATABASE_URL':'[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]'});assert b'Invalid local server configuration.' in b
run('check',['pnpm','check'],w);run('regression-migrate-after-check',['pnpm','db:migrate'],w)
run('api3',['pnpm','test:integration'],w);run('privacy5',['pnpm','test:dev-privacy'],w);run('http16',['pnpm','test:step07'],w)
for mode in ['production','development']:
 newdb(mode);env.pop('E2E_MODE',None)
 if mode=='development':env['E2E_MODE']='dev'
 assert not(w/'.env').exists();run(mode+'18-noenv',['pnpm','test:e2e'],w)
 if(w/'test-results').exists():shutil.copytree(w/'test-results',s/(mode+'-test-results'))
env.pop('E2E_MODE',None);run('engineering',['pnpm','build:step07'],w);assert subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=w)==b'';print('LATEST_FROZEN_NOENV_CHECKS_FULL_API_BOTH_BROWSER_MODES_ENGINEERING_COMPLETE',flush=True)
